verdict.rationale: RunAnywhere ships official SDKs from 'one C++ core, six thin bindings', with an SDK repo on GitHub. First-party docs show a deep Swift API covering streaming generation, chat, tool calling, structured output, STT/TTS/VAD, VLM, image generation and model downloads, plus a Kotlin SDK and a React Native/Expo integration path. Community failure reports concern the rcli tool rather than the SDKs. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of the SDKs, and documentation evidence for the remaining bindings beyond Swift, Kotlin and React Native.
